source: Actual isolated WebGPU naval battle; no raster-generated backdrop
reproduction: Open a frozen local build with ?menuqa=1, wait for window.__menuScene.info().ready, let it run about six simulated seconds, pause(true), hide .menu-inner/.menu-masthead/.menu-foot/.menu-shade, and capture at the specified viewport. Encode the canvas frame as WebP quality 92. Runtime variation in frame timing can change individual smoke/shot positions.
note: The recurring 3D scene remains the primary background. Posters are used before graphics are ready, for reduced motion/save-data and on graphics initialization failure. The renderer caps its native canvas width at 1600 pixels.
nonVisualChangesSinceCapture: Menu-only squadron debug labels changed to ASCII for strict localization audit; scene geometry, lighting, camera and simulation are unchanged.
